title: 📜 Rajasthan History — One-liners
text:
• Haldighati yudh: 18 June 1576 — Maharana Pratap vs Mughal sena (Man Singh)
• Chittorgarh durg: Mori vansh ke Chitrangada ne banwaya (maanyata)
• Jaisalmer durg: Rawal Jaisal (1155 AD)
• Kumbhalgarh durg: Rana Kumbha
• Vijay Stambh (Chittorgarh): Rana Kumbha ne — Mahmud Khilji par vijay ke smaran me
• Amer durg: Raja Man Singh I
• Hawa Mahal, Jaipur (1799): Sawai Pratap Singh — 956 jharokhe
• Meera Bai ki shaadi: Mewar ke Yuvraj Bhojraj se
• Rajasthan Diwas: 30 March (1949 — Greater Rajasthan ka nirman)
• Matsya Sangh (18 March 1948): Alwar, Bharatpur, Dholpur, Karauli
• 'Prithviraj Raso': Chand Bardai
• 'Rajasthan ka Gandhi': Gokulbhai Bhatt
• Panchayati Raj ki shuruaat: Nagaur (Rajasthan), 2 Oct 1959, Pt. Nehri ke haathon se

title: 🗺️ Rajasthan Geography — Quick Facts
text:
• Kshetrafal: lagbhag 3.42 lakh sq km — Bharat ka sabse bada rajya (kul kshetrafal ka ~10.4%)
• Sabse uncha sthan: Guru Shikhar, Mount Abu (~1722 m) — Aravali shreni
• Aravali: duniya ki sabse purani gati shailiyon (fold mountains) me se ek
• Sabse lambi nadi (Rajasthan me): Chambal
• Luni nadi: Naga pahad (Ajmer) se nikal kar Rann of Kachchh me samapt — namkeen pani
• Sabse bada jila (kshetrafal): Jaisalmer
• Sambhar jheel: sabse badi namkeen (salt) pani ki jheel — namak utpadan bhi hota hai
• Jaisamand jheel: Gomti nadi par (Udaipur)
• 'Rajasthan ka Cherrapunji': Jhalawar (sabse zyada barish)
• Thar marusthal = 'Marusthali'

title: 🏛️ Rajasthan Polity — Quick Facts
text:
• Vidhan Sabha ki kul shaktiyan: 200 vidhayak
• High Court: Jodhpur (mukhya) — Jaipur me bench
• Pehla mukhyamantri: Heera Lal Shastri
• Lok Sabha seats: 25 | Rajya Sabha seats: 10
• Panchayati Raj pilot: Nagaur, 2 October 1959
• Bharat me sabse pehla Sainik School: Dholpur me khola gaya
• Panchayati Raj 3 star: Zila Parishad > Panchayat Samiti > Gram Panchayat
• 'Rajasthan' naam: 30 March 1949 se hi officially prayog me aaya

title: 🎭 Rajasthan Art & Culture — Quick Facts
text:
• Rajya pakshi: Godavan (Great Indian Bustard)
• Rajya vriksh: Khejri
• Rajya pushp: Rohida
• Kalbelia nritya: UNESCO intangible heritage list (2010)
• Puskar mela: Kartik Purnima par
• Karni Mata mandir: Deshnok (Bikaner) — 'chuhon wala mandir'
• Phad chitrakala: Shahpura, Bhilwara
• Pichwai chitrakala: Nathdwara
• Shahar ke naqsh: Jaipur = Gulabi, Jodhpur = Surya Nagri, Jaisalmer = Sunahri, Udaipur = Jheelon ka Shahar
• Ghoomar, Kalbelia, Gair, Terah Taali — Rajasthan ke pramukh lok nritya
